name: @lovrozagar/grunt
description: Multi-agent orchestrator SoT — deep-merge rulesync trees, product scripts, and generate pipeline into a consumer repo
author: lovrozagar

scripts.rulesync:generate: rulesync generate -t claudecode,codexcli,antigravity-cli,grokcli -f rules,subagents,skills && rulesync generate -t claudecode,codexcli,antigravity-cli -f hooks && node scripts/emit-mcp-policy.mjs && node scripts/emit-gemini.mjs && node scripts/emit-agent-shell-tools.mjs && node scripts/hooks-union.mjs
scripts.rulesync:watch: node scripts/emit-mcp-policy.mjs && node scripts/emit-gemini.mjs && node scripts/emit-agent-shell-tools.mjs && rulesync generate -t claudecode,codexcli,antigravity-cli,grokcli -f rules,subagents,skills --watch
scripts.rulesync:check: rulesync generate -t claudecode,codexcli,antigravity-cli,grokcli -f rules,skills --check && rulesync generate -t codexcli,antigravity-cli,grokcli -f subagents --check && rulesync generate -t claudecode,codexcli,antigravity-cli -f hooks --check && node scripts/emit-mcp-policy.mjs --check && node scripts/emit-gemini.mjs --check && node scripts/emit-agent-shell-tools.mjs --check && node scripts/check-globals.mjs && node scripts/hooks-union.mjs --check
